EN.tagline: Right Patient. Right Priority. Right Route.
EN.hero_title: Empowering Community Healthcare Through Smarter Visits
EN.hero_subtitle: Risk-weighted patient prioritization and optimized visit scheduling for ASHA & ANM workers.
EN.problem_desc: ASHA and ANM workers manage 50+ assigned families across vast rural and semi-urban areas. Without dynamic risk-weighted tools, critical follow-ups are delayed by static geographic lists.
EN.route_headline: The shortest route isn't always the safest route.
EN.route_desc: Our multi-variable algorithm balances Clinical Risk + Travel Distance + Urgent Windows + Worker Workload.

HI.tagline: सही मरीज। सही प्राथमिकता। सही रास्ता।
HI.hero_title: स्मार्ट दौरों के माध्यम से सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा को सशक्त बनाना
HI.hero_subtitle: आशा और एएनएम कार्यकर्ताओं के लिए जोखिम-भारित रोगी प्राथमिकता और अनुकूलित दौरा अनुसूची।
HI.problem_desc: आशा कार्यकर्ता 50 से अधिक परिवारों की देखभाल करती हैं। सही प्राथमिकता के बिना गंभीर रोगियों के गृह भ्रमण में देरी हो जाती है।
HI.route_headline: सबसे छोटा रास्ता हमेशा सबसे सुरक्षित रास्ता नहीं होता।
HI.route_desc: हमारा एल्गोरिदम नैदानिक जोखिम + यात्रा दूरी + आपातकालीन समय + कार्यभार को संतुलित करता है।

patients.name: Meena Devi
patients.address: House 42, Near Govt School, Beelwa Village, Sitapura
patients.condition: Pregnancy 34 Weeks - Severe Anemia & Gestational Hypertension
patients.reasonSummary: 3rd trimester pregnancy + blood pressure spikes + severe anemia + missed previous checkup.
patients.recommendedAction: Immediate home checkup. Take BP & fetal heart rate. Prepare for referral to Mahatma Gandhi Hospital if BP stays > 140/90.

patients.name: Ramdev Sharma
patients.condition: Type 2 Diabetes + Post Stroke Recovery + Dyspnea Symptoms
patients.reasonSummary: Elderly diabetic post-stroke patient reporting breathlessness and elevated systolic BP.
patients.recommendedAction: Evaluate blood glucose, O2 saturation, and compliance. Dispense emergency anti-hypertensive if prescribed.

patients.name: Pooja Sharma (Child: Aarav)
patients.condition: SAM (Severe Acute Malnutrition) Follow-up + Delayed Pentavalent Vaccine
patients.reasonSummary: Infant with severe acute malnutrition monitoring and overdue immunization booster.
riskFactors: MUAC tape in yellow/red zone (< 11.5 cm)
Overdue for Pentavalent 3 vaccine by 2 weeks
patients.recommendedAction: Administer Pentavalent booster, measure MUAC, provide Ready-to-Use Therapeutic Food (RUTF) sachets.

communityStories.name: Sunita Devi
communityStories.story: Earlier, I had to memorize or write on paper which pregnant mother needed urgent checks. With EK ASHA's risk scoring, I instantly know that Meena Devi with high BP needs me first, saving critical time for pre-eclampsia intervention.

communityStories.name: Meena Devi
communityStories.story: During my 8th month, my BP surged suddenly. My assigned ASHA received a priority alert on EK ASHA and arrived within 40 minutes to guide me to Mahatma Gandhi Hospital safely.
